features.description: 73 keys E1-E7 (43 white, 30 black), white/black pattern, key geometry and hit-testing; rendered keybed.
Six ordered sections at the visual-spec widths, 54/46 deck/keybed split, measured aspect, continuous chassis.
Unique stable control ids per section, per-section landmarks and density, drawbars only in Organ, Program/Synth as the only OLEDs.
Pointer and touch press/release/cancel/lost-capture, independent multi-touch, focused-key Space/Enter with repeat suppression, roving focus, blur release.

Every button/knob/fader/drawbar/wheel/stick/encoder moves or lights via pointer and keyboard, and operating all of them changes no audio, voice, display or status. Phase 2: scoped to the controls that remain decorative (Organ, Synth, Program and spec-excluded); functional controls describe what they control.
Accessible names, roles, values and descriptions for every control, keyboard focus and operation, aria-pressed toggles, labelled keybed and OLED status regions, visible focus styles.
Note on/off, repeated and overlapping notes, release, all-notes-off, dispose, node/source cleanup to baseline (rendered through the Web Audio simulator).

Pointer, independent multi-touch, mapped computer keys with repeat suppression and octave shift, MIDI note/velocity/CC64/CC120/CC123, denied/unsupported/no-input/disconnected MIDI, audible velocity and sustain through the piano voice.
Sustain transitions and multiple sustain sources, concurrent voices, deterministic voice stealing, velocity level and brightness response.

Truthful loading/ready/fallback/error/suspended status and MIDI status; blur, hidden tab, MIDI disconnect, all-notes-off and unmount stop every owned voice and return sources and listeners to baseline.

No marketing hero or reference-image background, attached chassis/cheeks/rails, all 73 keys inside the instrument, stage sizing for 1440x900 (88-97 % width, no vertical scroll) and 390x844 (full-width, scaled as one unit).

Six selectable types (Grand, Upright, Electric, Clav, Digital, Misc) with 1-2 models each; Grand/Upright/Electric play bundled recorded sample packs (roots + velocity layers) offline, audibly distinct from each other and from the synthesized types; provenance in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json matches every pack zone.

Two layers with enable/focus button logic, level faders, octave shift (±12 semitones), per-layer voice ownership (one NoteEngine per layer), layer disable/section off freeing only owned voices, and cleanup to baseline.
KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre (acoustic/electric families incl. Dyno), Unison, Soft Release (not for Clav), String Res and Master Level each measurably change rendered audio and show in panel feedback.

Sustain from the UI toggle, computer keyboard Space and MIDI CC64 through the layered engine, honouring per-layer SUSTPED (Shift+Layer A) including toggling while the pedal is down; String Res responds to the pedal; no soft/sostenuto behaviour is claimed.
A failed sample pack reports 'fallback' (never ready), names the failure in status, Program OLED (LOAD FAILED) and a flashing type LED, and the model still plays the labelled synthesized fallback.

One AudioContext; per-layer buses → Timbre EQ → Mod1 → Mod2 → Delay → Amp/EQ → Comp → Reverb → layer level → (direct | shared Rotary) → master gain → limiter → ceiling → single destination; Master Level 0 silences everything; ramps avoid clicks; dispose frees every node, LFO and voice.

FX focus follows layer focus, manual Piano focus button, Group (Shift+focus), Global for Delay/Comp/Reverb (Shift+On), per-unit bypass, Layer Effects ON all-bypass, dry/wet, documented order (reverb before rotary), delay feedback path, To Rotary routing and shared rotary speed.

Every unit and every listed type (Mod1 x6, Mod2 x6, Delay with Off/HP/LP/BP feedback filter and tap tempo, Amp Sim EQ/Small/JC/Twin/LP24/HP24/To Rotary, Compressor with Fast, Reverb x6 with Bright/Dark, Rotary slow/fast/drive) measurably changes a standardized rendered signal versus bypass and versus the other types.

All Phase 1 test files remain present and green; decorative-only assertions were narrowed to the controls that stay decorative, and the keybed/input/voice lifecycle tests run against the Phase 2 engine through the app.
